purpose: Test whether a causal delay-risk model multiplied by pre-release M4 opportunity transports across held-out model families, workloads, and acquisitions better than conventional pre-release alternatives. This is a deployment bridge, not validation of downstream learning utility.

analysis_population.window: Each acquisition's registered primary window; Llama versions 8 through 407 and each Qwen cell's frozen full window.
analysis_population.treatment: registered five-second release hold versus immediate release
analysis_population.outcome: terminal failure to deliver the registered opportunity
analysis_population.opportunity: pre-hold group L1 sum of absolute scalar GRPO advantage times valid actor tokens

feature_timing: Only facts recorded no later than release_delay_started may enter a predictor. Treatment arm may enter because assignment was randomized before the hold; terminal selection, removal, ready latency, consumption version, and later learner state are prohibited.
conventional_features: start learner version scaled within the registered window
active release holds at hold start

candidate_scores.conventional_delay_risk: arm-specific terminal non-delivery probability contrast from the conventional predictor
candidate_scores.reward_variance_at_risk: nonnegative conventional delay-risk contrast times reward variance
candidate_scores.m4_at_risk: nonnegative conventional delay-risk contrast times registered M4 L1
candidate_scores.m4_augmented_at_risk: nonnegative probability contrast from the conventional predictor augmented with log1p M4 and zero-opportunity indicator, times M4 L1

predictor.form: Separate fixed-form L2-regularized logistic models for immediate and delayed arms
predictor.standardization: Training partition means and population standard deviations only
predictor.missing_values: Training-partition median imputation plus one missingness indicator per feature
predictor.optimization: Deterministic implementation with fixed learning schedule, convergence tolerance, and iteration cap recorded by the analyzer
predictor.outcome_blinding: Each held-out partition is excluded from all fitting and standardization

transport_splits: leave-one-workload-out for OpenMath, GSM8K, and NuminaMath

opportunity_ranking: fraction of observed lost M4 captured in the top 10 percent of assignments
fraction captured in the top 20 percent
mean inverse-probability weighted causal lost-opportunity pseudo-outcome in the top 10 percent
metrics.aggregation: Report every held-out partition, assignment-weighted pooled values, and equal-acquisition macro values. The leave-one-acquisition-out macro top-10 capture difference between m4_at_risk and reward_variance_at_risk is primary.

primary_hypothesis: M4 at risk has greater equal-acquisition mean top-10 observed-lost-opportunity capture than reward variance at risk under leave-one-acquisition-out prediction.

decision_rule.pass: The primary difference is positive, both family-direction differences are nonnegative, all authentication and no-leakage gates pass, and the result reproduces byte-for-byte.
decision_rule.fail: Any authentication/no-leakage/reproduction gate fails, or the primary difference is nonpositive, or either family-direction difference is negative.
decision_rule.interpretation: Pass authorizes design of an independent gradient-utility audit. It does not authorize a quality acquisition or establish that M4 is learning utility. Fail blocks promotion of causal-risk scheduling and redirects the paper to measurement only.

prohibited: tuning thresholds or model form on held-out outcomes
calling this analysis a new randomized acquisition
calling prediction of Q times non-delivery independent validation of Q
claiming terminal-quality improvement, mediation, or production readiness
